title: Probe Accuracy as an Early Warning for Model Misalignment

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear chain: if probe accuracy degradation predicts safety benchmark degradation before it is observable in outputs, this is a proactive monitoring tool preventing deployment of misaligned models. Direct operational safety application.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires setting up a longitudinal monitoring pipeline, performing multiple fine-tuning updates, re-evaluating probes after each update, and running safety benchmarks. This is a multi-step infrastructure project requiring significant ML engineering experience beyond beginner level.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Requires multiple fine-tuning iterations, probe re-evaluation after each, and comparison with downstream benchmarks. A longitudinal study is inherently broad. Would need to be simplified to a single before/after comparison to fit in 30 hours.
